resource.name: Cutdown
resource.creator: Softworks
resource.description: Score footage for focus, exposure and motion, then export adjustable selects into Resolve. Free Lite; paid Pro. Local analysis with license checks.
resource.platformNotes: Apple Silicon macOS 12+ or Windows 10/11 x64. Windows ARM is not natively supported; Linux is planned. Resolve edition/version range is not established.

requirements.dependencies: Internet for license/update checks; media analysis remains on-device.
requirements.installation: Standalone Mac or Windows app; Apple Pro Video Formats is optional for wider Mac preview support.

evidence.note: Apple Silicon macOS 12+ or Windows 10/11 x64. Windows ARM is not natively supported; Linux is planned. Resolve edition/version range is not established.

Standalone footage analysis that scores focus, exposure and motion, then exports adjustable selects and markers to Resolve through AAF, FCPXML, FCP7 XML or OTIO. Deterministic analysis runs locally; camera-movement estimates can be wrong. Lite includes unrestricted footage analysis and export; paid Pro adds weighting, watch folders and deeper controls.
